description: Checkpoint critic predictions at identical states along one deterministic Simba-actor rollout.
actor: tanh(mean), lunar_simba actor specified by --simba; no random warm-up
critic_value: min(Q1, Q2); Simba Q values are expectations over the saved atom support
normalization: (Q - grid_min) / (grid_max - grid_min), independently per critic and sampled state

markers.pink plus: critic maximum on sampled action grid

limitations: One fixed seed and one checkpoint pair; not aggregate evaluation.
Each critic estimates returns under its own learned policy; raw scales differ.
Colors show relative predicted preferences, not probabilities or measured action quality.
The GIF pauses on the last sampled state before looping; the terminal scene is not shown separately.
helper: tmp_/make_critic_heatmap.py is intentionally gitignored; checkpoints are local artifacts.
